title: Use library profiles for final promotion settings
summary: Removes the standalone Settings Final Library Promotion editor and makes Library Profiles the operator-facing source for promotion destinations. Library Profile saves now write FinalLibraryPromotionEnabled from profile promotion checkboxes and generate FinalLibraryPromotionRules only from enabled profiles with explicit promotion destinations.
reason: The separate manual source-to-destination rule editor duplicated the per-library promotion destination workflow and could preserve stale manual rules after library-profile saves.
behavior_before: Settings exposed a separate Final Library Promotion panel with manual enable, verification, cleanup, overwrite, and source-to-destination rule controls. Library Profile saves generated profile-derived rules but also retained existing manual FinalLibraryPromotionRules as fallback rules.
behavior_after: Settings no longer exposes the standalone Final Library Promotion editor. Operators configure promotion per Library Profile through promotion_destination and promotion_enabled, and Library Profile saves generate only profile-derived promotion rules while disabling global final-library promotion when no enabled profile has promotion enabled.
